bias.zh: 反弹 · 回到 10 日均线和 $62.6

read.en: Intel rose 7.5% on Nov 11 to $62.50, trading $60.96–64.06. It is above the 5-day ($57.71), level with the 10-day ($62.51) and below the 30-day ($87.81), 100-day ($99.59) and 200-day ($87.28); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($79.16), and RSI is 34.2.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月11日上涨 7.5%，收于 $62.50，盘中区间 $60.96–64.06。股价位于 5 日均线（$57.71）上方，与 10 日均线（$62.51）持平，位于 30 日（$87.81）、100 日（$99.59）和 200 日均线（$87.28）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$79.16），RSI 为 34.2。

read.en: The rally reclaimed $58.3–58.4 and the $60–60.7 highs, now support; the $64.06 high cleared the $62.59 Nov 3 high, but the close slipped back to it and the 10-day. Resistance is $62.5–62.6, then $64.1 (Nov 11 high) and $65.7 (Nov 2 high). Support is $60–61, then $57.7–58.4 (5-day, Nov 4 close) and $56.8. A close above $62.6 would target $64–65.7; below $60, $58.

s.en: Nov 11 low $60.96; Nov 9 high $60.03; Nov 4 high $60.2; Nov 10 high $60.65, reclaimed
